svg.title: Bioinformatics Project Scaffold Architecture Overview
svg.desc: Organizational scaffold routing config/default.yaml into scripts/01_process_data.py, verifying immutable data/raw/, creating data/processed/, appending logs/01_process_data.log, and reserving notebooks/ and results/ for downstream workflows.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bioinformatics Project Template — Reproducible Directory & CLI Scaffold

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Standalone organizational scaffold · CLI + YAML routing + immutable raw data boundary (stub processing)
